general.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

wizard.title: New listing
wizard.sourcesHint: Drop the manufacturer PDF data sheets here. The information for the listing is taken exclusively from these files.
wizard.dropzoneText: Drop PDF files here or click to select
wizard.onlyPdfWarning: Only PDF files are supported. Other files were skipped.
wizard.fieldNotesHelp: Extra facts for the generation, e.g. copied text from the manufacturer's website.
wizard.fieldLanguageHelp: Splac generates and creates this product only in the selected language.
wizard.fieldProductNameHelp: A short hint which product is being listed, e.g. "Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 5".
wizard.fieldCategoryTemplateHelp: The LLM creates a new category based on this template.
wizard.extendedBetaRequired: {provider} is not officially supported and requires Extended Beta mode. Enable it in the Splac plugin configuration or select Anthropic.
wizard.extendedBetaActive: {provider} is running in Extended Beta mode. This provider is experimental and is not officially supported by Splac.
wizard.reasoningHelp: Let the model spend additional tokens analysing complex source material before producing the final structured output.
wizard.batchHelp: Submit generation through the provider's asynchronous batch API for lower-cost, non-urgent processing.
wizard.batchTiming: Batch jobs can take longer. Progress continues automatically in the message queue.
wizard.providerUnsupported: Not available with the configured provider ({provider}).
wizard.startSuccess: The listing process has been started.

review.title: Review
review.generatingBanner: Splac is working on this listing. This page refreshes automatically.
review.emptyFieldsWarning: The following fields could not be found in the sources
review.fieldManufacturerHelp: If empty, a new manufacturer is created from the name below.
review.fieldCategoryKeywordsHelp: Separate keywords with commas. The terms are stored on the created Shopware category.
review.fieldCategoryParentHelp: Review where the generated category will be placed. Leave empty to create it at the root level.
review.categoryCreationHelp: Approving this listing creates the reviewed category first, then assigns the new product to it. Nothing is created before approval.
review.categoryCreatedHelp: This reviewed category was created together with the product.
review.categoryApprovalBlocked: The generated category needs a name before this listing can be approved.
review.categoryNameRequired: Enter a name for every category language before approving.

templates.title: Templates
templates.importModalHelp: Review the template before adding it. Importing always creates a new template and never replaces existing data.
templates.importDuplicateWarning: A template with this name already exists. You can change the name now or import it as a separate copy.
templates.importCategoryNotice: Parent categories are specific to each shop and are not included in template files. Select the parent category after importing.
templates.importErrorInvalid: The selected file does not contain valid JSON.
templates.importErrorFormat: This is not a valid Splac template file.
templates.importErrorVersion: This template file was created with an unsupported format version.
templates.importErrorTooLarge: The template file is too large. Select a JSON file smaller than 2 MB.
templates.importErrorNameLength: The template name must not exceed 255 characters.

templateDetail.fieldProductNumberPatternHelp: Use model in curly braces as placeholder for the product model, e.g. LAP-...
templateDetail.fieldTargetMarketPlaceholder: e.g. IT managers at German small and medium-sized businesses who value reliability and easy deployment
templateDetail.fieldTargetMarketHelp: Splac uses this audience context to choose the emphasis, terminology, and tone across the listing.
templateDetail.descriptionFormattingHelp: Explicitly enable the presentation rules this preset should add to generated product descriptions.
templateDetail.blockSpacingHelp: Adds consistent visual breathing room after every description block in all languages.
templateDetail.tableFormattingToggleHelp: When enabled, each table block exposes border, columns, alignment, padding, and cell-spacing controls.
templateDetail.tablePresetApplyAllTitle: Use Clean specifications for all tables
templateDetail.tablePresetApplyAllHelp: Updates existing tables now and uses this style automatically for tables created later.
templateDetail.optionalHeadingHelp: Adds a semantic heading directly above this text block.
templateDetail.blockInstructionHelp: Splac writes the complete content of this block using the product sources and this instruction.
templateDetail.headingInstructionPlaceholder: e.g. Write a short heading naming the product family
templateDetail.paragraphInstructionPlaceholder: e.g. Summarize the most important benefits in two concise sentences
templateDetail.staticTextHelp: This text is copied into every generated description unchanged.
templateDetail.inlinePlaceholderHelp: Optional dynamic values can be inserted by enclosing a placeholder name in double curly braces.
templateDetail.imageAltHelp: Describe the image for screen readers and when the image cannot load.
templateDetail.imageUrlInvalid: Enter a valid HTTP(S), storefront, or Shopware media URL.
templateDetail.imageMediaLoadError: The selected Shopware image could not be loaded.
templateDetail.conditionHelp: Splac reads the named fact from the product sources and selects exactly one branch for the final description.
templateDetail.conditionFieldHelp: Use a clear, unique fact name without spaces. Splac extracts this fact from the uploaded product sources.
templateDetail.conditionElse: Content when the condition does not match

conditionOperator.greaterThanOrEqual: Number is greater than or equal to
conditionOperator.lessThanOrEqual: Number is less than or equal to

templateDetail.tablePresetHelp: Apply a professionally balanced starting point, then fine-tune any setting below.
templateDetail.tableSourceFieldHelp: A unique name without spaces. Splac fills this value from the product sources.
templateDetail.tableFieldInstructionButton: Add AI guidance for this property
templateDetail.tableFieldInstructionHelp: Explain how the LLM should extract or format this specific property. This instruction is attached only to this table field and cannot override source grounding.
templateDetail.tableFieldInstructionPlaceholder: e.g. Use the sustained power value, not the short-term peak; include watts
templateDetail.legacyHtmlHint: This block came from an existing HTML template. It remains unchanged and can be replaced with new blocks over time.
templateDetail.modeInstruction: Instruction: LLM writes the whole text
templateDetail.instructionModeExample: e.g. Write a concise SEO title that mentions brand and model
templateDetail.placeholderModeExample: e.g. Our [product_name_plural] are refurbished by our staff
templateDetail.errorConditionIncomplete: Complete every if/else condition with a source fact and, where required, a comparison value.
